posts.title: New Graphics modes
posts.description: Quite a lot of interest was recently shown when I asked if anyone would be interested in additional graphics modes for the AppleSqueezer GS Turbo. So, I added some new modes, which I think offer a lot of possibilities. posts.title: AppleSqueezer GS Turbo
posts.description: Today, I'm really happy to announce a brand new AppleSqueezer accelerator: the AppleSqueezer GS Turbo. And as you may well guess from its name, the main difference is in the speed, although it's not limited to that. It comes with quite a few other improvements as well!
